provenance.purpose: frozen verification evidence; no runtime authority

schema_snapshot.title: kora graph IR
schema_snapshot.description: Draft JSON Schema for kora IR version 1.x. Root is lenient on unknown keys; typed sub-objects are strict. Keys prefixed with x- are allowed on IR record objects, including nested records. Named maps and embedded schemas retain their own rules.

meta.description: Compiler provenance; never read by the scheduler

type_contracts.description: Authoritative used type closure. List[T] is derived from T. No runtime registry alias lookup.

retention.description: Graph-level retention; absent fields take the namespace default. Cleanup deletes payloads only; metadata stays.

expression.description: CEL expression; limits and checking in ir.md section 7

artifactType.description: Structural spelling only. Semantic validation parses recursive List[T] and rejects unbalanced nesting without imposing a depth limit.

path.description: dotted path into the source artifact or params; for $inputs the subgraph input name

schema.description: JSON Schema of the payload for StructuredOutput and custom types

collect.description: fan_out nodes only: the body output collected into this List output

toolPolicy.description: The tool-call policy of a node (DD-29, S2-2): allow and deny patterns in the harness tool-pattern syntax, evaluated per layer together with the namespace policy: a deny in either layer wins, every layer with a non-empty allow list must match, and order inside an array has no effect

digest.description: package or image digest the server is pinned to; filled at deploy when absent

from_ref.description: input path of a VcsRef to check out instead of rev

harness.description: Harness adapter name (claude, codex in MVP); the form acp:<agent> is reserved for the ACP adapter after MVP and fails semantic validation with IR018 until that adapter is installed (ADR-0004)

form.description: Absent selects the built-in decision/comments form. An explicit schema is preserved; response values are never filled from schema defaults.

approve_when.description: When absent, response.decision == 'approve' applies only when the effective form declares decision and the expression passes CEL checking; otherwise IR011. Explicit expressions are preserved.

context.description: input path of the artifact shown to the approver, e.g. a ReviewBundle

sensor.description: sensor protocol implementation name; built-ins: change_request_status, ci_status, http

config.description: sensor-specific configuration, validated by the implementation

over.description: name of the node input (List typed) that is mapped; other inputs are bound unchanged to every instance

preset.description: preset id the resolved config was built from

outputs.description: Canonical IR requires the fixed role output; structural role violations map to IR003 in shared validation.

param.description: a run parameter of graph.params; bound when the run is created

path.description: one scalar string in a top-level node output; key binds once when the complete source result is atomically accepted (ADR-0019)

on_active.description: what a new run does while another run of the namespace holds the same target; when absent: allow (FR-6.11, ADR-0014)

version.description: the author's own version of the graph; informational

overlap.description: When absent: queue for webhook starts, allow for other triggers. Skip considers accepted pending/running runs; queue promotion selects the oldest pending run under the graph lock when none is running. Canonical accepted/skip outcomes are durable (FR-6.2, ADR-0020).

max_running_nodes.description: Live graph-wide cap on all non-terminal physical attempts across graph versions; cap source is the newest active graph version, or newest deployed when none is active (ADR-0020).

max_running_runs.description: Live graph-wide cap on distinct runs with any non-terminal physical attempt, including historical or unknown work; no-attempt waits reserve no execution-run slot. Counts span versions and caps use the newest active graph version, or newest deployed when none is active (ADR-0020).

protected_paths.description: glob patterns of gate files agent nodes may not edit and command gates verify against the base commit (DD-34)

provider_retry.description: waiting allowed for model-provider limits before failing with provider_limited (ADR-0024)
